text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-25, a crash loop was discovered in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml affecting sessions routed through the OAuth provider.","The root cause of the crash loop was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The crash loop manifested as containers restarting a few seconds after startup.","The crash loop resulted in 18 duplicate rows being written per day.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test via PR #4528 on branch fix/crash-loop-1.","The issue could be reproduced by rolling out the deployment to the small node pool.","This crash loop occurred in the same area of infra/k8s/deployment.yaml as previous crash loop work."]}
